findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The bottom of the dish drying rack. 
2. The bottom of the drink cooler in the storage room.

This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The top of the inside of the ice machine is observed to have slight soil residue accumulation on it. CORRECTED- The PIC cleaned this during the inspection and was educated on the importance of maintaining it clean. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: There were cases of drinks being stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Ensure that all food is stored at least 6 inches above the floor to protect them from contamination. 

(A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-602.11: (D) Observed baffle of ice machine to be soiled with debris.  FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750-830g The facility did not have a test kit available for the sanitizing agent present. The facility was unaware of the need and use of a sanitizing kit. Provided during the inspection. Use the kit to check the concentration of the sanitizing sink. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a package of hot dogs and a package of pre-cooked bratwurst to not have a date when the package was originally opened. Staff noted packages were opened yesterday. Packages were dated to correct the violation. Limit ready-to-eat, potentially hazardous foods to maximum 7 days holding once the original package is opened. Use or discard after day 7.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the cove base below the ice machine to be detached from the wall. Re-attach the coving to allow for a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed the coffee filters to be improperly stored. Store single service articles in closed containers which will protect them from possible contamination. Items were properly coverd to correct the violation.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The ceiling of the microwave is soiled with food splash.  Wash, rinse, sanitize and maintain this surface.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
One stack of Styrofoam bowls found under the hand sink.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED - Bowls were moved out from underneath the hand sink plumbing.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
[1] The floor under the ice machine for beer coolers is in disrepair.  It appears the laminate floor has been destroyed in one spot.  Repair the floor to be smooth and easily cleanable.
[2] The following floors are soiled:
(A) floor under beer-cooler ice machine (wet, soiled), 
(B) floor under soda syrup boxes.
Repair or clean these floors to be smooth and easily cleanable and remove food, water, and harborage for potential pests.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Ice scoop for red ice machine was resting on counter top with tea/coffee spill-stain.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED - Manager immediately placed scoop into single service cup to protect its cleanliness.  Recommended manager keep ice scoop in a container to keep it off counter surface (which may not always be sanitized).
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were in disrepair:  (a) men's restroom hand sink (mold) (REPEAT), (b) women's restroom hand sink (REPEAT), (c) gasket on silver Cornelius ice machine.  Repair these non-food contact surfaces.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

The ice scoop shall be stored on a clean, dry, washable surface or container.  Any water that accumulates from the ice scoop should drain properly out of the ice scoop holder.
